name: Miss Potts
source:
Originally hailing from the Strategy and Planning department of The Council, she was asked to do some teaching, which she agreed to, if somewhat reluctantly.

Miss Potts and Grendel get along fantastically, with the former regarding Grendel as her star pupil.

Miss Potts hates violence, which makes exam times extremely problematic.
